stem: Why was the bill in this cartoon important to President Franklin D. Roosevelt?

options.label: F
options.text: He wanted to strengthen the congressional power of impeachment.

options.label: G
options.text: He wanted to strengthen federal judicial authority over state governments.

options.label: H
options.text: He wanted to remove congressional leaders from office.

options.label: J
options.text: He wanted to weaken the power of the judicial branch over the executive.

visual_elements: Two men are depicted in front of a fireplace. One man, labeled 'OPPOSITION,' is holding a large rolled-up paper labeled 'SUPREME COURT BILL' and saying, 'I'M GOING TO TOSS IT IN!' The other man, labeled 'F.D.R.,' is pleading, 'JUST A MINUTE, MY FRIEND–LET'S TALK THIS OVER!'
